description: Composer text that may hold a secret, so isn't saved as a draft, stays in the tab. The screen is the default 393x727 phone. The conversation /c/{{SLUG}} exists. Call "stored" returns the IDs of the secrets the server has stored for it, as a JSON array. Name elements by ARIA role and accessible name, as Playwright's getByRole does (visible elements only); "named X" means an exact name match. "The composer" is [data-testid="message-input"], "the row" [data-testid="secret-bar"] and "its button" [data-testid="secret-bar-action"]. The conversation {{OTHER}} exists too, and {{SLUG}}'s id is {{ID}}. "The drafts" means the result of eval Object.keys(localStorage).filter((k) => k.startsWith("shelley-draft:")).map((k) => localStorage.getItem(k)).join(" "). "Paste X" means eval (() => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="message-input"]'); el.focus(); el.value += X; el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent("input", { bubbles: true, inputType: "insertFromPaste" })); })(). To "open conversation X": if the button with aria-label "Open conversations" is visible, click it; then wait for .conversation-item[data-conversation-id="X"] to be visible, click it, and wait until it has the class "active". After call "hold sends", messages sent to a conversation wait for call "release sends"; after call "hold checks", the composer's secret checks wait for call "release checks". {{CHAT}} is Shelley's new conversation page with a chat from the bookmarklet whose selection holds a database URL with the password "Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6". Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{SLUG}}. Fill the composer with "note: ". The drafts should contain "note: " (allow 10s). 2. Paste "postgres://app:Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7@db.internal:5432/app". The row should contain the text "Captured on send" (allow 10s). Click the composer, press End and type " later". 3. Open conversation {{OTHER}}. The composer should have the value exactly "" (allow 10s). 4. Open conversation {{ID}}. The composer should have the value exactly "note: postgres://app:Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7@db.internal:5432/app later" (allow 10s). 5. Click the visible button with class "btn-new" (named "New Conversation"). The URL should come to end with "/new" (allow 10s). Open conversation {{ID}}. The composer should have the value exactly "note: postgres://app:Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7@db.internal:5432/app later" (allow 10s). The drafts must not contain "Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7". 6. The row should contain "Captured on send" (allow 10s). Click its button; the row should contain "Sent as text". Click the composer, press End and type " thanks". Wait longer than the composer takes to save a draft: eval new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve('waited'), 1500)) expecting "waited". The drafts must not contain "Tz8qWm3RkP5vX7". Click its button; the row should contain "Captured on send". 7. Fill the composer with "". The drafts must come to not contain "note: " (allow 10s). Paste "postgres://app:Zx9cVb2NmQ4wE6@db.internal/app". The row should contain "Captured on send" (allow 10s). Click the composer, press End and type " sent-while-away". Call "hold sends". Click [data-testid="send-button"]. Open conversation {{OTHER}}. Call "release sends". Open conversation {{ID}}. The page should contain the text "sent-while-away" (allow 30s), and then the composer must have the value exactly "". 8. Call "hold checks". Navigate to {{CHAT}}. The composer should contain "Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6" (allow 10s). Click the composer, press End and type " x". Wait longer than the composer takes to save a draft: eval new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(() => resolve('waited'), 1500)) expecting "waited". The drafts must not contain "Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6". 9. Call "release checks". The row should contain "Captured on send" (allow 10s). The drafts must not contain "Hd4sYt8MzJ3cW6".
